messages:
mia: Heads-up — noticed a big spike in SSE fanout errors for tenant-id=acme while quota throttled. Lots of reconnect loops. Logs show fanout_drop tag. Anyone else seeing this?
jon: yep saw it around 11:07 UTC. per-route rate limiter churned and clients started reconnecting. console showed increase in 'reconnect_count' metric.
priya: logs? can you paste a minimal snippet?
mia: pasted below:
```
2023-11-03T11:07:12Z route=eu-west fanout=128 tenant=acme action=throttle reason=token_quota limit=1000 fanout_drop=64 reconnect=1
2023-11-03T11:07:13Z route=eu-west proxy=proxy-12 reconnect_attempt=2 error=EPIPE
```
jon: TL;DR is: when fanout > quota we drop connections but still charge reconnects; console shows routing policy as "round_robin" which fans to many backend shards.
oliver: product: we need better UX in console — show 'fanout trim' in traces and a direct link to affected tenants. Also suggest a roll-out: surface "soft throttle" before hard drop.
priya: SRE concern: soft throttle is tricky — if we keep clients connected but degrade, we risk tail latency. Proposal: trim prefixes (prefix cache) first, then soft-throttle new streams.
mia: config proposal (very rough):
```
fanout_policy:
  max_fanout_per_tenant: 64
  pretrim_cache: true
  soft_throttle_pct: 50
  soft_throttle_window_sec: 30
```
jon: +1 for telemetry tags. Also add console annotation for affected time windows and an alert that counts reconnects per tenant > 10/min.
oliver: UX ask: add a toggle in rollout UI to enable "simulate fanout trim" in canary for X% tenants. We can let solutions try before enabling.
deploy-bot: canary:eng-platform/fanout-trim v3 deployed to 10% at 11:32 UTC :rocket:
priya: quick question — how do we account billing? currently reconnects are billed; if we artificially drop connections because of fanout trimming, ops want credits back or at least not inflate billing.
mia: agree — need per-tenant billing annotation when policy triggers: add tag billing_adjust=fanout_trim to traces.
jon: implementation note: kernel has an atomic decrement on fanout counters, need to ensure we decrement when we drop sockets; otherwise metrics overcount.
mia: next steps: (1) add 'fanout_trim' tag in rho-telemetry; (2) console: show timeline + simulate toggle; (3) small policy yaml + canary; (4) verify billing label path. Volunteers?
priya: I'll take (1) and (4).
jon: I'll do (2) with console team.
mia: I'll coordinate the canary and write the rollout playbook.
oliver: I'll write the UX copy and notify solutions.
jon: also ping @security about any rate-limiter bypass vectors.
mia: thanks everyone. filing a follow-up doc with the playbook and required telemetry fields :+1:
